tools.name: get_design
tools.description: Returns one design from the NightMarquee library: its build prompt for the chosen coding tool, its live demo link and whether a starter project is available. tools.name: get_footage
tools.description: Returns short-lived download links for the video clips and images a design's live demo uses, with each file's role, length and size. The links last ten minutes. Use it after get_design when you are building the design and want its footage. Free designs need a connected account; paid designs need a p

tools.name: get_starter
tools.description: Returns a short-lived download link for a design's runnable Next.js starter project, stamped for the connected account, with the steps to run it. tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Returns the connected account's email, its own plan name if it has one, its credit balance and how many starter downloads and site checks are left today. Read-only. Needs a connected account.

tools.name: check_site
tools.description: Starts NightMarquee's AI-look check of a public website and returns a job. Read the result with get_job, which asks you to come back in a few seconds. tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Returns the status of a job started by check_site, given its id. While the status is queued or running, wait the number of seconds in retryAfterSeconds and call again. A finished check returns the score, a link to the result page and the problems found, most severe first, each with where it was seen

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account · Private data: get_footage · Public sink: get_account, check_site · Destructive: get_starter, check_site.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account · Private data: get_footage · Public sink: get_account, check_site · Destructive: get_starter, check_site

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
